hero.title: I build AI systems that hold up in production.
hero.subtitle: I connect RAG, document processing, vector databases, and MCP across backend and infrastructure.

statement.note: I design beyond the visible feature: cause, boundaries, failure, and recovery.

architecture.title: I treated a model replacement as a data migration, not a settings change.
architecture.subtitle: The old service stays live while new embeddings are prepared, and traffic moves only after verification.

experiencePreview.title: From data analysis to production AI systems.

aboutPreview.title: I turn complex systems into structures teams can understand and operate.
aboutPreview.body: I go beyond shipping a feature. I document reproduction, boundary design, deployment, and verification as decisions that can be reused.

process.title: I follow a problem from its cause through production.
process.body: I do not stop at patching the visible symptom. I build reproducible evidence, separate state from boundaries, and implement the flow with failure and recovery in mind.

steps.verify: Verify the complete path in production conditions.
